create_tracked_str: create a tracked_str instance to track the origin of string values
set_origin_tracked_str: set the origin of a tracked_str instance using the set_origin method
get_origin_tracked_str: get the origin of a tracked_str instance using the get_origin method
create_tracked_list: create a tracked_list instance that tracks the last item during iteration
create_tracked_iterable_from_generator: create a TrackedIterableFromGenerator to wrap a generator function as a resettable iterable
